question: Who among the following founded the Forward Bloc in 1939?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhash Chandra Bose**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose founded the Forward Bloc in 1939 after resigning from the Indian National Congress.
 
• The Forward Bloc was established to consolidate the political left and radical elements within the Indian independence movement.
 
• Bose formed the Forward Bloc to achieve complete independence for India and to challenge the British colonial rule more aggressively.
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose was a prominent leader in the Indian freedom struggle and played a crucial role in the formation of the Indian National Army (INA).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subhash Chandra Bose**

 
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose was born on January 23, 1897, in Cuttack, Odisha, India.
 
• He was an Indian nationalist whose defiant patriotism made him a hero in India.
 
• Bose advocated for complete and immediate independence from British rule, unlike the more gradual approach favored by Mahatma Gandhi and the Congress leadership.
 
• He was elected as the President of the Indian National Congress twice, in 1938 and 1939, but resigned from the Congress due to ideological differences with Gandhi and the Congress high command.
 
 
 
• **Indian National Congress**
 
 
• The Indian National Congress (INC) is a political party in India founded in 1885.
 
• The INC played a significant role in the Indian independence movement against British rule.
 
• Key leaders of the INC included Mahatma Gandhi, Jawaharlal Nehru, and Vallabhbhai Patel, among others.
 
 
 
• **Indian National Army (INA)**
 
 
• The Indian National Army (INA) was an armed force formed by Indian nationalists in 1942 in Southeast Asia during World War II.
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose took command of the INA in 1943 and sought to overthrow British rule in India with the help of Axis powers.
 
• The INA played a crucial role in the independence movement, inspiring many Indians to join the struggle for freedom.
